item.title: Army's Gatekeeper: Accelerating Innovation to Counter Digital Threats

item.title: Precision at Scale: Western Air Defenses Adapt to the Drone Swarm
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The drone swarm threat demands agile, cost-effective responses. Alexander Sterling dives into how BAE Systems' APKWS is rapidly reshaping Western air defense doctrine, from F-15Es to frontline UAVs. A true game-changer in precision at scale. #DefenseTech #NATO #C-UAS
[SPLIT] ⚡ Rapid integration across a broad spectrum of Western platforms—including F-15E, Eurofighter Typhoon, MQ-9A, and ground launchers—demonstrates its critical versatility and interoperability. [SPLIT] ⚡ The system democratizes precision strike capabilities, extending effective counter-UAS and multi-mission effects down to tactical unmanned platforms and battalion-level units.
